''See also: [[Nye Eldest Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[The Nye]] [[Eldest]], also known as the Eldest{{!}}Eldest Nye or Old [[Nye]], is the leader of [[the Nye]], a race of humanoid entities composed of Shadow{{!}}shadow and cloth. While most [[Nye]] are identical in appearance, the [[Eldest]] is distinguished by his great age, appearing hunched and wearing faded, storm-gray robes with exceptionally long, voluminous sleeves that hide his hands. He moves with a gliding motion as if he lacks feet and possesses a voice described as raspy or like a death rattle. Unlike many of his kind who are bound to [[the House]], the [[Eldest]] possesses greater mobility and capabilities, including the ability to see much and perform various tasks. He is deeply connected to the history of the [[Territory]], having lived through many centuries, and maintains a profound loyalty to his master, whom he awaits with devotion. Eldest{{!}}The Eldest serves as a keeper of [[the House]] and possesses significant power, such as the ability to manipulate light or move through walls, though he expresses a fear of his kind fading away if their power is not maintained. He acts as a guide and sometimes an adversary to humans, such as the son of [[Kalman]], often speaking in riddles or providing cryptic insights into the nature of the world and its [[inhabitants]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[The Nye]] [[Eldest]] is an aged individual. He wears a faded and worn outer robe.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|He possesses the power to produce a blue-white cloud of light from his hood. This individual can also access information without being told, such as the name of [[Simon]]'s father. Additionally, he has the capacity to restore an [[Incarnation]]'s body to [[Valinhall]] and transform them into an extension of the [[Territory]].}}
